digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow and macOS pytest execution
propositions: A proposal to move macOS pytest temporary trees from runner.temp to an ephemeral APFS RAM disk did not improve Gerrit Verify wall time; all treatment runs were slower than the no-RAM control by 5-7%.

Multiple independent macOS test runs on RAM disk (/Volumes/RebarTests) completed the same 13,397/65-skipped default suite in 18-21 minutes versus 17m26s on runner.temp, failing the predeclared 5% improvement threshold.

The RAM-disk experiment exposed two test infrastructure defects: intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures caused PermissionError during recursive cleanup, and nested pytest cacheprovider inheritance leaked .pytest_cache entries.

The experiment was reverted and merged; macOS pytest basetemp was restored byte-for-byte to runner.temp, the RAM-disk setup/reporting/cleanup lifecycle was removed, and all unchanged pytest selectors, xdist worker counts, timeouts, coverage flags, and platform matrix cells were preserved.
Final green run 31873067707 executed the restored no-RAM workflow successfully on macOS in 24m42s with all suites passing and cleanup detaching the temporary device without leakage.
